title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Arvind Sahakari Bank Ltd., Katol, Maharashtra
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBl) has, by an order dated July 16, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹11 lakh (Rupees Eleven Lakh only) on Arvind Sahakari Bank Ltd., Katol, Maharashtra (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Housing Finance for UCBs’ and ‘Interest Rate on Deposits’.
